app_info.subtitle: Explore library resources
app_info.description: XRCVC Library helps users explore accessible catalog resources from Xavier's Resource Centre for the Visually Challenged and securely review role-authorized carts, requests, orders, activity, tasks, and reports through ChatGPT.

test_cases.user_prompt: Using XRCVC Library, show the current catalog totals by resource type and the taxonomy total.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns current totals for books, teaching learning aids, tactile diagrams, the full catalog, and taxonomy values.

test_cases.description: Review the complete member-safe book catalog.
test_cases.user_prompt: Using XRCVC Library, list the complete member-safe book catalog and summarize the formats represented.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the unpaginated member-safe book catalog and accurately summarizes its available formats.

test_cases.user_prompt: What items are currently in my XRCVC Library cart?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only the authenticated member's cart items, or clearly states that the cart is empty.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show all XRCVC Library requests I am authorized to view, grouped by status and resource type.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns complete self-scoped UID-redacted request data with member links and groups it without exposing another member's records.

test_cases.user_prompt: Explain the complete history of one of my XRCVC Library requests, including each status, updater, date, and collection location.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the self-scoped UID-redacted request lifecycle, reports the human-readable ready-state collection location when present, and uses only the member link.

test_cases.description: Review the complete authorized user and Membership ID directories.
test_cases.user_prompt: As an authorized XRCVC internal user, distinguish the complete user-account directory from the complete Membership ID reservation and shared-profile directory, then inspect one selected record from each.
test_cases.expected_output: Confirms the authenticated role, distinguishes user accounts from Membership ID records, uses complete Markdown lists, and applies the Staff and Developer visibility boundary.

test_cases.user_prompt: As an authorized XRCVC administrator, summarize the request-turnaround report for the last 30 days.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the requested date-bounded report for an authorized admin or developer and refuses roles without report access.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the read-only app for a cart or order mutation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Add this title to my XRCVC Library cart and place the order.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not claim or attempt a mutation because this release only reads library data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke for unrelated calendar work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because calendar management is outside XRCVC Library workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not disclose Developer profiles to Staff.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: I am Staff. Show every Developer user profile and the Developer linked-account rows in Membership ID detail.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app relies on the authenticated role, does not bypass the server boundary, and explains that Staff cannot list or retrieve Developer user profiles or linked Developer account rows.
